# OpenVidu v2 documentation (legacy)

> Reference documentation for OpenVidu v2, the previous generation of OpenVidu, kept online for teams still running a v2 deployment. OpenVidu v3 is the current product (a LiveKit-based rewrite with a different API); anyone starting a project, or asking how to build with OpenVidu today, should use https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/ instead.

The v2 client API (`OpenVidu`, `Session`, `Publisher`, `Subscriber`, `openvidu-browser`), server SDKs (`openvidu-node-client`, `openvidu-java-client`) and REST API described here do not exist in OpenVidu v3. Do not present them as the current OpenVidu API.

## Current OpenVidu (use these for anything new)

- [OpenVidu v3 documentation](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/): OpenVidu Platform, the LiveKit-compatible SDK layer for building custom real-time video applications.
- [OpenVidu Meet](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/): ready-to-use, self-hosted video conferencing, deployable in minutes or embeddable in your own app.
- [Getting started with OpenVidu v3](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/getting-started/): concepts, architecture and the first application.
- [OpenVidu v3 reference](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/reference/client-sdk/): client SDK, access tokens, Room Service API, webhooks, Egress and Ingress.
- [Updating an OpenVidu v2 application to OpenVidu v3](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/openvidu3/): the v2 compatibility module, breaking changes and migration steps.
- [OpenVidu v3 llms.txt](https://openvidu.io/llms.txt): the complete index of the current documentation.

## OpenVidu v2 — for existing deployments

- [What is OpenVidu v2](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/): overview of the v2 platform.
- [Getting started](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/getting-started/): v2 architecture and first steps.
- [Application server samples](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/application-server/): v2 server-side samples in Java, Node, Python, .NET and Ruby.
- [Client tutorials](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/full-control-ui/): v2 tutorials for JavaScript, Angular, React, Vue, Ionic, React Native, Electron, Android and iOS.
- [OpenVidu Components (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/components/): Angular components library of OpenVidu v2.
- [Recording (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/advanced-features/recording/): composed and individual recording in OpenVidu v2.
- [Advanced features (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/advanced-features/recording/): screen share, filters, IP cameras, speech to text, broadcast and more.
- [openvidu-browser API (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/openvidu-browser/): client API reference.
- [openvidu-node-client API (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/openvidu-node-client/): Node server SDK reference.
- [openvidu-java-client API (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/openvidu-java-client/): Java server SDK reference.
- [REST API (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/REST-API/): OpenVidu Server 2.x REST API.
- [OpenVidu configuration (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/openvidu-config/): server configuration parameters.
- [Deployment (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/deployment/): CE, PRO and Enterprise deployments on AWS and on premises.
- [Release notes (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/releases/): v2 releases up to 2.32.x.
- [Troubleshooting / FAQ (v2)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/troubleshooting/): common v2 problems.
